## Description

Targets per patient for HbA1c, blood pressure, LDL, eGFR and urine albumin, with defaults the doctor can change; the chart shows each latest value against its target. Care gaps come from rules: diabetic eye and foot checks once a year, urine albumin once a year for diabetes, a test ordered but never resulted, vaccines due (MDV-P2-036), the glucose tolerance test window at 24–28 weeks of pregnancy, and a falls review after a fall. Each gap has an action (add to today's visit, order, refer). Care-plan goals are text with a target and progress.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each gap rule is tested for due, not due and done.
- [ ] **AC2.** A gap's action adds the item to the open consultation's plan; with no open consultation it says so.
- [ ] **AC3.** shortcut: the gap rules are the design's list and wait for clinical sign-off.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
